unresolved.decision: Assignment/reassignment owner, useful visibility interval, necessary contact/bag/notes projection and correction ownership. No all-driver default.
Correction/lifecycle compensation effects remain unapproved; no implied refund/credit.

listByRound.note: Minimal synthetic projection excludes personal fields until G-ROUND ratifies necessary fields.

productionAmendment.effect: Increment immutable production version, append amendment, require new acknowledgement before handover.

acknowledgement.effect: Append actor/version acknowledgement after live authorization; cannot acknowledge stale or unsafe version.

event.transport: Atomic durable outbox; immutable event identity; at-least-once delivery.

reconcile.meaning: Snapshot of current effective projection; prepared includes prepared and terminal states in this model. Corrections append history and adjust only effective projection.

requirements.statement: Live staff + known granted permission + versioned assignment + half-open useful window; deny unknown policy, other round and unauthorized direct access.

Append exactly one authoritative event/outbox on confirm/fail/correct; retries bind complete command payload and recheck authorization; correction keeps original event and needs explicit policy/reason.
Unsafe change creates blocking incident, preserves production version and prevents preparation/handover until reviewed resolution; no role override or silent regeneration.
Post-cutoff modification requires explicit scoped grant, reason, immutable amended production version and acknowledgement; no Administrator wildcard.

Reward/notification consume same original confirmed event with unique durable receipts. Unknown external outcome requires reconciliation before another effect; corrections do not create a second referral reward.
Expose not-prepared and unresolved-prepared counts; no disappearance of planned units. Failure requires exception owner and creates no credit.
Consumption J, production/delivery J-1 stay distinct. Server Africa/Casablanca calculator supplies versioned absolute cutoffs; reference does not solve timezone transitions.

verification.scope: Design-reference tests only; independent review and qualified external acceptance still required.
unproven: all-channel authorization and actual round assignments
